constraints.name: coop_document_revisions_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'draft'::text) AND ((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['create'::character varying, 'edit'::character varying])::text[])) AND (rendered_html IS NULL) AND (content_sha256 IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'generated'::text) AND ((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['generate'::character varying, 'regenerate'::character varying])::text[])) AND (rendered_html IS NOT NULL) AND (content_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (content_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

constraints.name: coop_documents_number_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((document_number IS NULL) OR (((document_number)::text = btrim((document_number)::text)) AND ((length((document_number)::text) >= 1) AND (length((document_number)::text) <= 80)))))

constraints.name: coop_reviews_actor_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((actor_role)::text = 'student'::text) AND (student_id IS NOT NULL) AND (teacher_id IS NULL) AND (department_staff_id IS NULL)) OR (((actor_role)::text = 'department_staff'::text) AND (department_staff_id IS NOT NULL) AND (teacher_id IS NULL) AND (student_id IS NULL)) OR (((actor_role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['teacher'::character varying, 'department_head'::character varying])::text[])) AND (teacher_id IS NOT NULL) AND (department_staff_id IS NULL) AND (student_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: coop_reviews_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((decision)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['reject'::character varying, 'cancel'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) > 0)))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: coop_reviews_transition_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((actor_role)::text = 'student'::text) AND ((decision)::text = 'submit'::text) AND ((from_status)::text = 'new'::text) AND ((to_status)::text = 'advisor_review'::text)) OR (((actor_role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['student'::character varying, 'department_staff'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((decision)::text = 'cancel'::text) AND ((from_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['submitted'::character varying, 'advisor_review'::character varying, 'staff_review'::character varying, 'department_head_review'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((to_status)::text = 'cancelled'::text)) OR (((actor_role)::text = 'teacher'::text) AND ((from_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['submitted'::character varying, 'advisor_review'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((((decision)::text = 'approve'::text) AND ((to_status)::text = 'department_head_review'::text)) OR (((decision)::text = 'reject'::text) AND ((to_status)::text = 'rejected'::text)))) OR (((actor_role)::text = 'department_head'::text) AND ((from_status)::text = 'department_head_review'::text) AND ((((decision)::text = 'approve'::text) AND ((to_status)::text = 'approved'::text)) OR (((decision)::text = 'reject'::text) AND ((to_status)::text = 'rejected'::text)))))) NOT VALID
